lines: One of an admiral's main jobs
is assigning duties.
Give each navigator a job
so the voyage goes smoothly.
Let's do that in Deck View.

source_row_count_notes.message: source has 3 line breaks; target has 2

lines: When you need to turn the ship
quickly, the Helmsman
is the one to count on.
A First Mate is optional, but lets
you negotiate with other powers
and keeps the crew from tiring
so fast at sea. An unsung hero.
With a Surveyor, you can use
Auto Move and see the fleet's
latitude and longitude.
It's an important job.

source_row_count_notes.message: source has 2 line breaks; target has 3

lines: At sea, the Lookout tells
you who other ships belong to and
what's happening in nearby towns.

source_row_count_notes.message: source has 1 line breaks; target has 2

lines: That's about all you need
to set sail. Try out the other jobs
and see what they do.
